newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi corn harvest continues, moisture high.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi corn harvest continues, moisture high.

text.p: Mississippi corn harvest continued at a swift pace during the week ended Sunday, but grain moisture continued high with some areas reporting 20 to 25 percent moisture, according to the state's Agricultural Statistics Service.
About 62 percent of the corn was harvested versus 72 last year and the 53 average. The crop was rated 12 percent excellent, 58 good, 25 fair, four poor and one very poor.

Boll rot was reported in some of the cotton. Harvest was nine percent completed versus 10 a year ago and the four average. Cotton was rated 15 percent excellent, 52 good, 30 fair, two poor and one very poor.
Soybeans were 20 percent harvested versus 22 a year ago and the six average. The crop was rated 13 excellent, 57 good, 25 fair, four poor and one very poor.
Sorghum was 81 percent harvested versus 62 a year ago and the 53 average. The crop was rated eight percent excellent, 55 good, 29 fair and eight poor.
Rice was 62 percent harvested versus 72 a year ago and the 38 average. The crop was rated 18 percent excellent, 58 good, 21 fair and three poor.
